title: 美国ICE拘留小镇：移民执法下的经济依赖
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: Good morning, Junch. Yes, I can hear you.
segments.zh: 早上好，Junch。是的，我能听到你。

segments.en: I begged you to give me a chance to speak. My father was transferred to there, and I was not given the opportunity to deal with a lawyer.
segments.zh: 我恳求你让我有机会说话。我父亲被转移到那里，我没有机会找律师。

segments.en: Carol Badeos is the US citizen who lives outside Miami, Florida.
segments.zh: Carol Badeos是居住在美国佛罗里达州迈阿密郊外的美国公民。

segments.en: She was expecting her father to land at the Miami airport, but he never made it to her.
segments.zh: 她原本期待父亲降落在迈阿密机场，但他从未到达她身边。

segments.en: And instead, she got a phone call a few days later that he was in nice detention facility.
segments.zh: 相反，几天后她接到电话，说他在移民拘留设施里。

segments.en: Please, I beg you to allow me the right to do process and allow me the right to speak.
segments.zh: 求求你，我恳求你允许我走程序，允许我发言。

segments.en: As an American citizen, I myself has the right.
segments.zh: 作为美国公民，我本人有这个权利。

segments.en: This was the start of what would be a very lengthy stay in ice detention.
segments.zh: 这是漫长移民拘留的开始。

segments.en: And for Carol, it was the start of this journey of trying to figure out where her father was when he was being moved to the next facility.
segments.zh: 对Carol来说，这是她试图弄清父亲被转移到下一个设施时在哪里的旅程的开始。

segments.en: What's happening now in the United States is beyond our control.
segments.zh: 现在美国发生的事情超出了我们的控制。

segments.en: The federal government has sased over that, but we do have a control here.
segments.zh: 联邦政府已对此有所控制，但我们这里确实有管控。

segments.en: Towns like Estonsea, New Mexico, small towns that a lot of people haven't even heard of have become pretty focal to the administration's goal
segments.zh: 像新墨西哥州的埃斯顿西亚这样的小镇，很多人甚至没听说过，却成了政府大规模移民执法行动的核心。

segments.zh: 执行这一大规模移民打击行动。

segments.en: The prison with a federal contract is a lifeblood for the town of Statench.
segments.zh: 这座有联邦合同的监狱是斯塔滕奇镇的命脉。
